valuation.method: Forward Adjusted Diluted EPS x justified P/E (FY2028E Adjusted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date in Nov 2027, anchored on FY2026 actuals of $41.35 and initial FY2027 guidance midpoint of $47.51).

bear.driver: Commercial aftermarket deceleration, acquisition integration drag, and higher-for-longer net interest expense (~$2.26B in FY2027)

base.driver: Steady commercial aftermarket and defense growth (~11% FY2028E EPS growth off FY2027E $47.51 midpoint) with ~52% EBITDA As Defined margin

bull.driver: Stronger commercial aerospace aftermarket pricing, faster margin recovery post-acquisitions, and accretive capital deployment

valuation.implied_by_close: At Base FY2028E Adjusted EPS ($52.75), the $1,217.28 close implies 23.1x (or 25.6x FY2027E guidance midpoint of $47.51); the 6-analyst sample targets ($1,300 to $1,745) imply 24.6x to 33.1x Base EPS, or $50.00 to $67.12 EPS at 26.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E on Base FY2028E Adjusted EPS moves the base target by $52.75 (4.3 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: Commercial aftermarket organic revenue growth and EBITDA As Defined margin (~52% FY2027 guidance)

analyst_notes: Following Q4 FY2026 earnings on Nov 10, 2026 (FY2026 Adjusted EPS $41.35; FY2027 Adjusted EPS guidance midpoint $47.51), Morgan Stanley ($1,405 from $1,300), TD Cowen ($1,350 from $1,300), and RBC ($1,300 from $1,200) raised targets while UBS trimmed to $1,481 (from $1,509). Note that BofA's Ronald Epstein cut to $1,550 on Nov 23, 2026, which is excluded as post-cutoff. The independent base case ($1,371.50, +12.7%) sits near the middle of post-earnings Hold/Buy targets, while Goldman's $1,745 target implies ~33.1x Base FY2028E EPS.
